title: Sauerbraten with Roast Rhubarb
description: A classic German pot roast marinated in vinegar and spices, served with a sweet and tangy roast rhubarb compote.

ingredients.name: beef pot roast
ingredients.notes: Choose a tougher cut of beef

ingredients.name: rhubarb
ingredients.notes: Roast rhubarb is a great accompaniment to sauerbraten

ingredients.name: roast vinegar
ingredients.notes: To give the beef a tangy flavor

ingredients.name: magical salt
ingredients.notes: To bring out the flavors of the dish

ingredients.name: caraway seeds
ingredients.notes: To add a traditional German flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the red wine, vinegar, salt, pepper, brown sugar, and caraway seeds.
Add the beef pot roast to the marinade and coat evenly.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 days.
Remove the beef from the marinade and place it in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot.
Add the sliced onions to the pot and cover it with a lid.
Roast the beef in the preheated oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
While the beef is cooking, prepare the roast rhubarb compote.
Cut the rhubarb into 1-inch pieces and toss with 2 tablespoons of brown sugar and 1 tablespoon of magical salt.
Roast the rhubarb in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until it's tender and caramelized.
Once the beef is cooked, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Serve the sliced beef with the roast rhubarb compote spooned over the top.
